    EloPeripheralManager.ExtHubType
    Used to handle external USB hub, the operation including: - enable/disable USB port - open cash drawer - control DP lanes to switch DP+USB2.0 and USB3.0 - hot plug detection The external USB hub list: - POS hub (for hand held models) - IO hub (for i-series and USBC models) - POS stand hub with CFD (for i-series and USBC project) - POS stand hub without CFD (for i-series and USBC project) - Flip stand hub (for i-series and USBC project)
